arena_report_anomalies: glm_ocr's OmniDoc board row (text Edit 0.0444) disagrees with its own per-page rows (0.0846); ANOMALY_NOTES.md explains it as a SUCCESS-only rescore over a 1,599-page filtered GT. This replay uses the full-corpus per-page rows, the conservative choice, exactly as Phase A did.
reports/full_compare_20260905/STATUS.md contains unrendered PowerShell template literals instead of substituted values and must not be quoted.
cost_and_latency_caveats: Cost is raw GPU provider cost from the campaign ledger, under an exploratory scheduling pattern with a 0.66 idle overhead ratio. It is never a per-page price and never sits beside a retail price.
opus5_subscription has no pod ledger: its cost is UNMEASURED, not zero, so every arm that invokes it reports an INCOMPLETE cost.
Latency is measured inference_ms from the per-page receipts. Queue time and cold start are excluded and are NOT modelled.
An arm's latency is the SUM over the routes it invoked, i.e. sequential execution. Parallel speculation would be lower; nothing here measures it.

not_measurable_ablations.no_authority: no authority source (SEC/XBRL/OpenDART) exists in the repository or the corpus
not_measurable_ablations.no_cold_start: cold start is a per-pod property in the ledger, not a per-unit one
not_measurable_ablations.no_independent_verifier: no verifier gate exists to switch off (WP-R9 is NOT_STARTED)
not_measurable_ablations.no_preflight: the corpus has no arrival-time preflight lane; every signal here is post-render
not_measurable_ablations.no_queue_state: queue depth at decision time is not recorded per unit
not_measurable_ablations.no_region_recovery: the Arena stores whole-page outputs only; no region crops were ever run
not_measurable_ablations.no_speculation: speculative execution produces no separate stored artifact to withhold
not_measurable_ablations.no_template_memory: no per-cluster outcome memory exists to ablate
not_measurable_ablations.no_temporal_or_identity: single-version corpus; no second version of any document exists
